question:

Each employee filled out a profile including three likes or hobbies. On the day of the gift exchange, only eleven gifts were given, each one specific to one of the recipient's interests. from docx import Document

path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"
doc = Document(path)

# Employees (2-13)
employees = []
for i in range(2, 14):
    t = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if t:
        employees.append(t)

# Profiles (21-32)
profiles = {}
for i in range(21, 33):
    line = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in line:
        name, rest = line.split(":", 1)
        interests = [x.strip() for x in rest.split(",")]
        profiles[name.strip()] = interests

# Gifts (36-46)
gifts = []
for i in range(36, 47):
    g = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if g:
        gifts.append(g)

print("Employees:")
for e in employees:
    print(e)

print("\nProfiles:")
for n, ints in profiles.items():
    print(n, ints)

print("\nGifts:")
for g in gifts:
    print(g)
```

# Map gift -> interest
gift_interest = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga"
}

matched = set()
for gift, interest in gift_interest.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if interest in ints:
            matched.add(name)

missing = set(employees) - matched
print("Matched employees:")
for m in sorted(matched):
    print(m)
print("\nMissing employees:")
for miss in sorted(missing):
    print(miss)
```
